# Math is Fun

> > A comprehensive K-12 math education platform combining interactive games, puzzles, worksheets, and tutorials across all major math subjects with visual learning tools.

Math is Fun provides free, illustrated math content designed to make mathematics engaging and accessible for students of all ages. The site features interactive tools, games, printable worksheets, and a comprehensive dictionary spanning foundational arithmetic through calculus, physics, and data science.

## Key Topics

- PEMDAS/BODMAS
- Algebra
- Geometry
- Calculus
- Derivatives and Limits
- Data and Probability
- Interactive Games
- Math Puzzles
- Worksheets
- Illustrated Dictionary
- Teacher Resources
- Student Engagement
- Measurement Systems
- Money and Finance
- Physics Fundamentals

## Core Navigation & Resources

- [Math is Fun](https://www.mathsisfun.com): Homepage: Math education with puzzles, games, worksheets for K-12
- [Index by Year and Subject](https://mathsisfun.com/links/index.html): Grade-level and subject navigation index for all Math is Fun content
- [Illustrated Mathematics Dictionary](https://mathsisfun.com/definitions/index.html): Illustrated math glossary with definitions and further reading links

## Interactive Games & Puzzles

- [Math Games - Puzzle, Number, Strategy, Logic and Multiplayer](https://mathsisfun.com/games/index.html): Hub for interactive games: Connect 4, Chess, Checkers, Reversi
- [Math and Logic Puzzles](https://mathsisfun.com/puzzles/index.html): Collection of math and logic puzzles including Sam Loyd and Einstein
- [Play 4 In A Line!](https://mathsisfun.com/games/connect4.html): Playable Connect 4 game with strategy and game rules explanation
- [Play Tilers Game](https://mathsisfun.com/games/tilers.html): Playable tile-matching puzzle game with keyboard controls

## Core Math Topics

- [Numbers ... !](https://mathsisfun.com/numbers/index.html): Number fundamentals, arithmetic, PEMDAS with educational games
- [Algebra Index](https://mathsisfun.com/algebra/index.html): Algebra fundamentals covering equations, exponents, polynomials
- [Geometry](https://mathsisfun.com/geometry/index.html): Plane and solid geometry tutorial covering shapes and properties
- [Calculus](https://mathsisfun.com/calculus/index.html): Calculus introduction: derivatives, integration, limits, optimization

## Applied Mathematics & Science

- [Data, Probability and Statistics](https://mathsisfun.com/data/index.html): Guide to data handling, probability, statistics with visualization methods
- [Measurement Index](https://mathsisfun.com/measure/index.html): Measurement systems, metric, US customary, unit conversions guide
- [Money](https://mathsisfun.com/money/index.html): Money basics, currencies, compound interest with interactive games
- [Physics Index](https://mathsisfun.com/physics/index.html): Physics fundamentals with metric system, motion, forces, energy

## Learning Tools & Worksheets

- [Math Worksheets - Free and Printable](https://mathsisfun.com/worksheets/index.html): Free printable math worksheets for K-12 practice and assessment
- [Math Activity Index](https://mathsisfun.com/activity/index.html): Hands-on math activities and projects for K-12 student engagement
- [Teacher's Page](https://mathsisfun.com/teacher-resources.html): Teacher resources, interactive tools, classroom activities guide
- [Color in the Number Chart](https://mathsisfun.com/numbers/number-chart.html): Interactive number chart activity for counting and pattern learning
